page.overview:
What is Allusis?

The Allusis was a Galactic Republic Valor-class starship. Astromech droid B5-2T was stationed on the ship.

The ship was named in memory of Jedi Master Belth Allusis,

The Allusis was the setting for a battle between Republic, Sith, and Mandalorian forces after Clan Varad hijacked the ship out of the Republic shipyards at Fondor.
